ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite imagery monitoring platform that tracks unauthorized space debris dumping and industrial land encroachment near aerospace facilities.
ideas.problem_statement: Graviton — Where AI Meets the Final Frontier: space-inspired innovation and artificial intelligence for real-world problem solving.
ideas.title: OrbitWatch AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the space-inspired innovation theme of the hackathon while delivering practical hard engineering similar to GeoNex-ATLAS.

ideas.pitch: A graph intelligence platform for aerospace supply chain risk detection, utilizing graph neural networks to spot anomalies in satellite component manufacturing.
ideas.problem_statement: Graviton — Where AI Meets the Final Frontier: emerging technologies and AI applications for complex industrial security.
ideas.title: CosmoGraph AML
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies proven graph intelligence architecture from the DIGITIMES winning project to a high-value aerospace supply chain use case.

ideas.pitch: A predictive modeling tool using Poisson GAMs and regression to forecast mission-critical anomalies and system failures in simulated rocket launches.
ideas.problem_statement: Graviton — Where AI Meets the Final Frontier: artificial intelligence for space exploration safety and incident forecasting.
ideas.title: AstroIncident Predictor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages rigorous statistical modeling and predictive calibration that won the Apart Research AI Forecasting Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered multimodal platform that ingests unstructured mission control telemetry, audio logs, and sensor feeds to make them instantly searchable and queryable.
ideas.problem_statement: Graviton — Where AI Meets the Final Frontier: transforming complex space and technical operational data into accessible intelligence.
ideas.title: MissionLog AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the winning formula of LibrAI by solving unstructured data overload with multimodal AI capabilities.

ideas.pitch: An AI-enhanced inventory tracking and lost-item portal tailored for space agency equipment depots, integrating Gemini multimodal search and real-time mapping.
ideas.problem_statement: Graviton — Where AI Meets the Final Frontier: operational efficiency and asset management using emerging AI technologies.
ideas.title: StellarFind
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts the proven architecture of GDG Hackathon winner Lumina to optimize logistical pain points familiar to large technical institutions.
